answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a per-identity stake bond agents post before attestations count. Each new key joins a registry slot backed by locked coins, and weight scales with stake, so splitting one wallet into a hundred identities multiplies the same locked capital by a hundred. That is the attacker cost: real voting weight needs funds locked per key, plus a wharf of registration fees and gas keeping each slot alive. Flooding is priced out. A velvet path stays open for honest scaling, since reputation lifts weight above the raven baseline.
